content.content: 1. Necessity: borrowed resolution needs the reading promise for the located node it resolves — without it, resolving is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Manner is where the lookup meets the reading; the gate keeps the use sound without testing resolution itself.
